Method of Attack: Phishing attack distributing malware via ZIP archives containing LNK files masquerading as documents
Two-stage infection process with PowerShell scripts launching decoy documents and downloading shellcode payloads
Use of legitimate cloud services (Microsoft OneDrive, Google Drive) for payload hosting and data exfiltration
Keylogging, file operations, remote code execution, and self-uninstallation capabilities
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (due to LNK files and PowerShell scripts)
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with links to ZIP archives containing malicious LNK files
Indicators of Compromise: ZIP archives with LNK files named 'Kang Min-chol edits'
Decoy document with embedded external image hosted on Heroku
Shellcode payload hosted on Microsoft OneDrive
Use of API keys to authenticate to Azure for command retrieval
File types targeted: PDF, DOCX, MP3, TXT, M4A, JPC, XLS, PPT, BIN, 3GP, MSG
